items.title: Hentoff Nat — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: "Who was this Cole Porter or Irving Berlin? That was old-hat stuff."

ctx.x: Your first name. Is it Nat?
My first name, which I hardly ever use, is Nathan. There’s a middle name, Irving, after some relative. But I’ve been Nat for a very long time.
Tell us about your parents: your father’s name, your mother’s name.
